PagerDuty: INCIDENT kv-cache-oom (P1) - hosted-runtime - multiple 503s observed; paging on-call

PagerDuty: triggered at 2024-06-03T15:07:14Z for service=hosted-runtime severity=SEV_P1
PagerDuty: symptoms=KV cache OOMs leading to failed token generation, backpressure on batcher

Alex R: acked, I’m on it. paging into #incidents.

Maya K: seeing ~4% 503s in prod for text-gen endpoints since 15:02 UTC. Error in logs: "kv_cache::alloc_failed: attempted reserve 1.2GB > limit".

Jihoon L: copying relevant logs: 
```
2024-06-03T15:04:11Z hosted-runtime-7b INFO request_id=abc123 model=gptx-8k seq=1 kv_cache_size=0.98GB
2024-06-03T15:04:11Z hosted-runtime-7b ERROR kv_cache::alloc_failed attempted reserve=1.2GB limit=1.0GB
2024-06-03T15:04:12Z hosted-runtime-7b WARN continuous_batching: batch_size=48 avg_seq_len=10240
```

Jihoon L: looks like runaway context windows + continuous batching caused per-request KV allocations to spike. batcher combined several long-context requests.

Emma S: initial customer impact: several enterprise tenants saw partial generation failures and increased latency — small percentage but recurring. No data leak.

Sam P: can we throttle by prompt length as stopgap? e.g., reject requests with context > 16k tokens with 413?

Alex R: yes, we should apply an immediate mitigation: 1) disable continuous batching for hosted runtime globally; 2) reduce kv cache limit per-request; 3) enable immediate-eviction policy. Doing them in order: disable batching first to stop aggregation of long prompts.

Maya K: rolling a hotfix flag now: 
```
# feature flag
redwoodctl feature set --env=prod hosted.continuous_batching=false --reason "kv cache OOM P1"
```

Infra Bot: rollout started. Canary on 3 nodes, then 30%.

Jihoon L: also applying a runtime guard to reject or downgrade requests with ctx > 12k tokens: 
```
# runtime config
KV_CACHE_MAX_TOKEN_WINDOW=12000
KV_CACHE_EVICTION_POLICY=immediate
```

Emma S: tagging affected customers + SRE.. opening incident page: https://intranet/redwood/incidents/1719961234

Sam P: any quick perf cliff from disabling batching? we'll lose some throughput but better than OOM sprawl.

Alex R: expected throughput drop ~15-20% for long-tail requests. ok for now. priority is stability.

Lucy T: added temporary rule in API gateway to 413 requests with header x-context-tokens > 12000: 
```
# gateway rule
if (x-context-tokens > 12000) return 413 Payload Too Large
```

Maya K: hotfix canary passed on nodes with flag disabled. moving to 30%. latency normalized for failing requests. No more alloc_failed logs on canary group.

PagerDuty: update notifications sent to on-call rotation.

Jihoon L: followup: need to patch continuous-batcher to add a per-request cap to avoid merging very long contexts into single batch. I'll open a PR for bounded-merge logic and a regression test.

Alex R: created short-term rollback plan: if we see increased 5xxs elsewhere, revert flag. Monitor dashboard: hosted-runtime kv_cache_errors, batch_size_distribution, p95 latency.

Emma S: customer comms draft: "We experienced a partial outage affecting some text-generation requests caused by long prompt sizes triggering KV cache memory limits. We've disabled continuous batching for hosted runtime and applied request guards. We're investigating root cause and will follow up."

Sam P: are there affected enterprise customers we should prioritize for 1:1 comms?

Maya K: flagged tenant: corp-fin (internal alias CF123) with higher error rates. CC: solutions-eng.

Alex R: on-call handoff: I need to step out in 20m. Jihoon, can you take lead for mitigation + PR?

Jihoon L: I’ll take it. will keep monitoring and push PR for bounded-merge.

Lucy T: monitoring alerts adjusted: added a spike guard on kv_cache_alloc_failures for 10m window to reduce noise.

Infra Bot: feature rollout at 100% by 15:18 UTC.

Maya K: metrics show failed request rate dropped to baseline and latency p95 came down from 1.6s to 0.9s for the affected routes.

Alex R: back briefly — good job. action items:
- Jihoon: PR for batcher bounded-merge + regression tests (due EOD).
- Infra: add limit to per-request KV cache allocation (per-model-config).
- Product/Support: coordinate comms for CF123 and any enterprise tenants.
- Postmortem: assign owner (Emma) to run blameless postmortem and publish within 72h.

Emma S: I’ll own postmortem. created doc: https://intranet/redwood/postmortems/kv-cache-oom-1719961234

Sam P: re: long-term fix — consider adaptive batching that uses token-length histograms to avoid merging long contexts, and backpressure on large-ctx requests instead of letting batcher combine them.

Jihoon L: agreed. also need to review default KV_CACHE_SIZE and model quantization memory assumptions.

PagerDuty: incident resolved at 2024-06-03T15:38:41Z — mitigation in prod.

Alex R: closing thread for active mitigation; please continue updates in postmortem doc and tag me. :thumbsup:
